_comment: First half of a chained pair for docs/components/episode-lifecycle.md (run manually, SAME session key as episode-multiturn-followup, back-to-back so the coordinator hasn't idle-closed the episode). A design task — the agent asks a clarifying question and stops (no_tool_calls), so the episode opens and stays OPEN (its plan, if any seeded, is never driven terminal). The follow-up should then ATTACH to this same episode rather than opening a new one.

message.content: Add a rate limiter to our public API and wire it into the request middleware. Before you touch code, walk me through the design decisions.

scripted_model_responses.content: Before I sketch an approach, two things: what's the expected peak requests-per-second, and should the limit be per-API-key or global across the whole service?
